### Added
- **Automation health: sequence senders that will fail.** The scan now flags
  enabled workflows that enroll contacts into a sequence sent as a deactivated
  user. A deactivated user holds no paid Sales or Service seat and no connected
  inbox, so those sends fail silently inside HubSpot. The report names the
  affected senders so you can reassign them or switch the workflow off. This reads
  the one slice of HubSpot's automation issues the API exposes; the full runtime
  issue list is not reachable from the API.
